map.三相总电流 = 总功率 / (√3 × 电压 × 功率因数)；单相设备电流 =: Three-phase total current = total power / (√3 × voltage × power factor); single-phase equipment current = power / (voltage × power factor). Three-phase loads must be split evenly across the three phases before adding the single-phase circuits.
